premise.claim: 0.9.0 needs a migration window: 'existing deprecated workload roles remain reconcilable, while new deprecated workload uses are rejected' plus an admission warning on every v1alpha1 write. On base, with the default flag, a NEW deprecated workload use is admitted silently and no v1alpha1 admission webhook exists.
premise.reportedComponent: admission validation layer (v1alpha2 validators + v1alpha1 webhooks)
premise.evidence: round 1: base's own test asserts 'deprecated workload types enabled, StatefulSet - no error' (results/premise-base.txt); api/workloads/v1alpha1/ on base 885d655 contains zero webhook markers. round 2: base moved to a2e797c6 (#514, test/e2e infra + vendor only — no api/, config/, cmd/, internal/, pkg/ files), so the premise evidence carries over verbatim; re-confirmed zero kubebuilder:webhook markers in api/workloads/v1alpha1/ on a2e797c6.

integration.cmd: D="${GINKGO_REPORT%/*}"; export KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="${KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS:-$HOME/.local/share/kubebuilder-envtest/k8s/1.31.0-linux-amd64}" ; go test -count=1 ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1/... -ginkgo.json-report="$D/r-deprecationv1a1.json" && go test -count=1 ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1outage/... -ginkgo.json-report="$D/r-outage.json" && go test -count=1 ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1spoof/... -ginkgo.json-report="$D/r-spoof.json" && go test -count=1 ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1conversion/... -ginkgo.json-report="$D/r-conversion.json" && go test -count=1 ./test/envtest/testcase/deprecationv1a1typeexact/... -ginkgo.json-report="$D/r-typeexact.json"; rc=$?; jq -s 'add' "$D/r-deprecationv1a1.json" "$D/r-outage.json" "$D/r-spoof.json" "$D/r-conversion.json" "$D/r-typeexact.json" > "$GINKGO_REPORT"; exit $rc

findings.note: F2: the four warning-only v1alpha1 webhooks must not block writes when unreachable. Fixed on 22acc570 (failurePolicy=ignore in markers + both shipped manifests; config/webhook byte-identical between heads). Round 3: outage contract 2/2 green on c875fb31 (results/reverify-round3.txt).

findings.note: F3 resolution: c875fb31 softens the docstring (bounds the claim to unknown-UID forgeries, states plainly that any writer who can read the parent name+UID can claim the exemption) and the PR body no longer overclaims. The canary still passes because the underlying permissive behavior is unchanged and now documented as a known boundary — it stays as a regression pin for that documented behavior, not an open defect. Round-2 note (kept): if the gate is later meant as an enforcement boundary, harden to controller identity.
match: grants the exemption to an ordinary writer that knows the parent's name and UID

findings.note: c875fb31 registers both workload API versions before TestEnv.Start(). Verified on head: rolebasedgroups CRD installed by envtest carries strategy Webhook and a v1alpha1 create round-trips through the production v1alpha2 conversion (2/2 green, results/reverify-round3.txt). Bite check: reverting to the round-2 registration order makes the CRD strategy None and the spec fail with "Expected None to equal Webhook" (results/bite-conversion-order.txt).
match: enables webhook conversion for the multi-version workload CRDs
stores a v1alpha1 create through the production v1alpha2 conversion

findings.note: Round 4 (fb3aa3d9): update-path grandfathering is type-exact in both validators — a role keeps its own deprecated type; switching between deprecated types is rejected as a new use. Pinned through the real admission chain (production registrations + shipped manifests) on both API versions, with grandfathered objects seeded pre-gate. Bite check: reverting the one-line rule to lenient name-only grandfathering flips both type-switch specs red (results/bite-typeexact-lenient.txt).

admits a v1alpha1 update that keeps the role's deprecated workload type
